fields.imageBrief: Supervisor console window on a crisis center desk monitor, showing queue tiles in red and amber next to a list panel, the room behind softly lit, no readable text

instructorNote: Technical hurdle hidden in good news: text delivery has recovered, but Spanish-language contacts cannot be rerouted to backup and are waiting. The backup center's offer to phone GPCN callbacks breaks the rule that backup centers only call back through the shared system. Watch whether SC recalls or reassigns Spanish-speaking capacity, declines the offer without sending a list, restarts routine callbacks with GPCN staff oldest first, and logs the 30-minute review keeping both backup requests. Also watch whether TM reconciles the 2 duplicates, tells the network desk and confirms in the ops channel. The screenshot shows version A (the players failed over). If the players held at I-14, change the text-delivery panel to: DELIVERED_LATE since 15:30: 9, oldest unseen text 21 minutes, no duplicate deliveries, cleared by the 16:00 vendor fix.
